note: What a triple looks like in the world (key: "Base + Tint + Second"). Every triple needs a line here, or the site build fails.
Fire + Cold + Lightning: The discharge follows the temperature gradient.
Fire + Cold + Blunt: Thermal shock makes the bones brittle.
Fire + Cold + Piercing: A hot puncture leaves a burned-through channel.
Fire + Lightning + Cold: After the burn jumps, the air cools sharply.
Fire + Lightning + Piercing: Ionization makes the puncture more accurate.
Fire + Blood + Cold: The blood thickens from the cold.
Fire + Blood + Blunt: A blow to a burning wound tears it open.
Fire + Blood + Piercing: A deep puncture into a burning wound.
Fire + Blunt + Cold: A blow to a heated body makes condensation.
Fire + Blunt + Lightning: The impact discharge runs through the burning cells.
Fire + Blunt + Blood: A heavy blow opens the vessels.
Fire + Blunt + Piercing: A concentrated blow pierces and throws further.
Fire + Piercing + Lightning: The discharge follows the puncture exactly.
Fire + Piercing + Blood: The puncture opens a large vessel.
Fire + Piercing + Blunt: A shock wave around the puncture.
Cold + Fire + Blunt: A blow to a thawing body breaks it.
Cold + Fire + Piercing: A puncture through ice leaves a crack.
Cold + Lightning + Fire: A jump of the freeze and a sudden heat.
Cold + Lightning + Blunt: A blow to a frozen neighbour shatters the ice.
Cold + Blood + Blunt: A blow to a weakened body.
Cold + Blunt + Lightning: The discharge runs along the cracks of the ice.
Cold + Blunt + Piercing: A precise blow to the brittle.
Cold + Piercing + Blood: A deep wound in a frozen body.
Cold + Piercing + Blunt: A shock wave around the puncture.
Lightning + Fire + Cold: After the shock and the burn comes a sharp cooling.
Lightning + Fire + Blunt: A blow to a shocked, burning target.
Lightning + Fire + Piercing: A puncture through an ionized target.
Lightning + Cold + Fire: A discharge on ice makes steam.
Lightning + Cold + Blunt: A blow to a frozen target breaks it.
Lightning + Blood + Fire: The blood boils in the chain.
Lightning + Blood + Cold: Cold blood conducts worse, but longer.
Lightning + Blunt + Fire: A discharge and a blow make a flash.
Lightning + Blunt + Cold: After the blow the body cools.
Lightning + Blunt + Blood: An open wound conducts the blow.
Lightning + Piercing + Blunt: A shock wave around the puncture.
Blood + Fire + Blunt: A blow to a burning wound.
Blood + Fire + Piercing: A deep channel in a burning wound.
Blood + Lightning + Blunt: A blow renews the ticks and stuns.
Blood + Blunt + Fire: A blow to the wound sets it on fire.
Blood + Blunt + Cold: After the blow the blood cools.
Blood + Blunt + Piercing: A concentrated blow into the wound.
Blood + Piercing + Fire: A hot channel cauterizes the edges.
Blood + Piercing + Blunt: A shock wave around a deep wound.
Blunt + Blood + Fire: The shock wave sets the blood on fire.
Piercing + Fire + Blunt: A shock wave around the puncture.
Piercing + Blood + Lightning: A discharge into a deep wound.
Piercing + Blunt + Fire: A hot puncture pins the target.
Piercing + Blunt + Lightning: A discharge at the pinning point.
Piercing + Blunt + Blood: A deep wound at the point of impact.
